recipes.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Correct a game animation. Use the attached flag bearer: jingasa iron hat, beige shirt, black lamellar vest, grey trousers, white shin wraps and sandals, tall indigo banner with EXACT same white comb-shaped clan emblem as reference only as an EXACT character identity reference. Create six NEW consecutive full-body walking drawings facing RIGHT, 3 columns x 2 rows in reading order. True transparent alpha, crisp hand-drawn illustrated game art matching reference, no text or effects or floor shadows. Fixed side-three-quarter camera and identical body proportions/head size in all six frames. Tall flag or long weapon must remain completely visible with comfortable clear transparent gutters, no figure/weapon touches another, no equipment clipping at canvas edges. Make a FULL LEFT-THEN-RIGHT LEG WALK CYCLE, not six similar spread-leg standing poses. This foot-spacing requirement is the main change: Frame1 WIDE CONTACT with viewer-near foot far forward to RIGHT and far foot behind LEFT; Frame2 NARROWING with both feet closer under hips and far heel lifting; Frame3 PASSING, ankles almost overlap under pelvis, far knee lifting past planted near leg; Frame4 WIDE OPPOSITE CONTACT, now FAR leg extended forward RIGHT and viewer-near leg stretched backward LEFT; Frame5 NARROWING with viewer-near heel lifting as both legs approach; Frame6 PASSING, knees/ankles almost overlap, viewer-near leg swings forward to return to frame1. Foot gaps about 55%, 25%, 5%, 55%, 25%, 5% of anatomical body height. Clearly alternate the leading leg; row2 must NOT repeat row1 with the same front leg. Arms hold the same equipment naturally, slight arm/cloth follow-through; torso and head remain consistent. Empty space around drawings is required. Keep a single consistent anatomical scale across all frames, no motion blur, no resized-copy poses. Minimum target standing anatomical body height around 320 source pixels excluding flag/weapon, but keep all equipment fully inside the image.
